title: Map Hover Selection Context-Menu Panning
description: Add multi-feature hover and selection (left/right partial-vs-full, default/additive/subtractive/invertive, rectangle + lasso) to map Positions and Routes, move panning to middle button, add right-click context menu.
summary: Implemented map hover, multi-selection (rectangle/lasso, partial/full, default/additive/subtractive/invertive), middle-button pan, right-click context menu for Positions and Routes. WASM hit-testing and highlight rendering; React MapCanvas interaction rewrite; MapPlayController toolbar and panel sync; MapPlayHost wiring.
